assumptions: Rigid opaque filament and a 0.4 mm nozzle are used.
Parallel-ray binary views are the exact geometry certificate; stated finite phone distances are setup intent.

components.form: Union of rounded 4 mm owl and rabbit silhouette slabs with shallow supported fox relief and a reinforced crown bridge.
components.interfaces: No assembly interface; ordinary external phone light and nearby wall only.
components.name: Unified fox-crescent dual-shadow caster
components.placement: Z minimum on print bed; slab intersection centered at X=Y=0.
components.purpose: Held sculpture, hand control, owl occluder, and rabbit occluder in one print.

concept.intended_interaction: Stand Z vertical, place a phone flashlight 250–600 mm behind the object and a wall 300–1000 mm beyond it, align one broad face parallel to the wall for the owl, then rotate the entire object 90 degrees about Z for the rabbit.
concept.signature_decision: Use two broad perpendicular silhouette slabs whose edge-on spines remain inside the other authored animal, making both projected outer stories traceable to the same one-piece CAD rather than to a render trick.
concept.summary: A single broad crossed-mask sculpture: shallow curled-fox relief sits beneath a bifurcated crescent-like crown; one exact axis projects a horned owl and a 90-degree turn projects a leaping rabbit.
concept.title: Pocket Eclipse Menagerie
unresolved_risks: No physical print or phone-light cast was observed.
Brightness, penumbra, multi-emitter phone artifacts, wall texture, and human recognition remain physically unverified.
The held fox/crescent reading is supported by exact relief and render inspection but not human playtest evidence.

research.evidence_boundary: Binary CAD projections prove occluding outline only, not physical brightness, edge softness, room tolerance, successful printing, or human recognition.
research.geometry_basis: Broad perpendicular masks make each named view a direct projection of one authored polygon; the cross-axis mask is constrained to a narrow spine within the other story.
research.light_model: Parallel rays certify the exact silhouette; a phone LED is treated as an approximate point source for setup. Similar-triangle magnification is (source-object + object-wall)/(source-object).
rejected_mechanisms: Perforated rotating shell: fussy alignment and fragile detail.
Forest of narrow fins: visually generic and fragile.
Composited render or painted cue: not traceable to exact solid geometry.
